name: Jan Otto-Trąmpczyński

events.type: Recorded his wife's dowry of 6,000 złp on half his estates

events.note: Partition of Trąbczyn, Nowa Wieś, Osiny and Łazy among the three brothers, made at Trąbczyn.
With his brother Andrzej and their mother; the regest of 1692 calls him son of Władysław.

notes: The database makes this Jan a son of the younger Władysław; the regest of 1692 and the partition of 1693 make him Władysław's son and the younger Władysław's brother, and the edition keeps to them.
